headlines.title: 구윤철 " 영남권 에 6개 기업 이 312조원+α 투자할 것"
headlines.summary: "반도체·로봇·우주항공 등 첨단산업 거점으로 육성하겠다" 부산 전력반도체·구미 로봇·창원 SMR 등 지역별 전략 제시 SMR 국가전략기술 지정·동남권투자공사 설립 등 추진 [진주=뉴시스] 조성봉 기자 = 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 3일 경남 진주에서 열린 영남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회에서 영남권 산업발전 비전을 발표하고 있다. 2026.07.

headlines.title: 정부, SMR 국가전략기술 지정 검토
headlines.summary: 지정 땐 연구개발 세액공제율 상향 이재명 대통령이 3일 경남 진주시에서 열린 영남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회에서 축사를 하고 있다. /뉴스1 정부가 소형모듈원자로(SMR)를 국가전략기술로 지정하는 방안을 검토한다고 3일 밝혔다.

headlines.title: AI 로봇 점유율 20% 목표 … 2030년 '피지컬 AI' 세계 1위 로
headlines.summary: "제조 경쟁력에 AI로봇 결합해 생산성↑" 액추에이터 등 취약 부품 국산화 새만금·대구경북권 중심 양산체제 "휴머노이드 로봇 점유율 20%로" 김정관 산업통상부 장관이 29일 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 '대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트 국민보고회'에서 정책 발표를 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 6개 기업, 영남권에 피지컬 AI-우주항공 312조 투자
headlines.summary: 진주서 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’ 보고회 삼성-SK-현대차-LG-한화 등 참여 이재명 대통령이 3일 경남 진주시에서 열린 영남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회에서 축사를 하고 있다. 진주=뉴스1 삼성, SK, 현대차, LG, 한화, 두산 등 주요 기업들이 영남권에 피지컬 인공지능(AI)과 우주항공 산업 등에 312조 원을 투자한다.

headlines.title: " 메가 프로젝트로 韓 성장률 3.5% 가능 "
headlines.summary: IB, 엇갈린 투자효과 분석 씨티, 성장률 0.4%P 상향조정 모건스탠리, 생산성 향상 기대 메모리 다운사이클이 최대 변수 블룸버그, 팹 분산땐 역효과 '메가프로젝트'를 놓고 외국계 금융기관이 한국 경제의 성장률과 생산성을 끌어올리는 원동력이 될 수 있다고 평가하면서도, 반도체 산업의 집적 효과는 약화될 수 있다고 염려했다. 목소리가 엇갈린 것이다.

headlines.title: 고가 메모리 비중 줄었나 … 시장 흔든 K반도체 kg당 수출단가 하락

headlines.title: 고환율 직격탄 맞은 中企 … 정부, 15조 규모 대출·보증

headlines.title: 다시 불붙은 '적정 외환보유액' 논란

key_headlines.title: LG Electronics' Bathroom Ventilation System 'Bas Air' Achieves 120% Monthly Sales Growth

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's semiconductor sector is driving record export figures, yet per-kilogram DRAM export prices are declining, suggesting a shift toward lower-priced products and potential market overheating. Meanwhile, LG Electronics' innovative bathroom ventilation system is experiencing explosive growth with 120% monthly sales increases, tapping into previously underserved consumer segments. The government is aggressively pursuing mega-projects to achieve 3.5% economic growth, combining AI robotics with traditional manufacturing strengths. However, economic expansion is not translating evenly across sectors, with significant employment concerns emerging despite strong headline growth figures.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Korea's economic growth rate is projected at 2.5-2.6% for 2026, driven primarily by semiconductor exports and AI infrastructure investments. However, employment elasticity is expected to reach just 0.23-0.24, the lowest level since 2018, indicating jobless growth concerns. The OECD warned that without fiscal reforms, government debt could balloon to 200% of GDP by 2050, though structural reforms and productivity improvements could stabilize debt at 60% by 2060. Consumer inflation is projected at 2.6% for 2026 and 2.2% for 2027, while unemployment rates are expected to edge down slightly to 2.8% and 2.7% respectively. The disconnect between strong export growth and weak employment generation represents a critical policy challenge.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean financial regulators warned that rising market interest rates can trigger significant bond losses, with 30-year bond prices potentially dropping 17% on a 100 basis point rate increase. The Bank of Korea cautioned against single-stock leverage ETFs concentrated in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, warning they could amplify market concentration and volatility as these two companies account for over half of KOSPI market capitalization. Memory chip prices, particularly DDR5, are emerging as critical leading indicators for Korean bond yields and growth forecasts, replacing traditional US monetary policy factors. The KOSPI is targeting the 10,000 level amid relatively stable global conditions and moderating inflation expectations.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector remains Korea's economic engine, with SK and Samsung announcing massive regional investments totaling over 600 trillion won across multiple regions for advanced chip production, AI data centers, and related industries. European EV battery material demand is strengthening, benefiting Korean battery suppliers as companies establish local manufacturing to meet European supply chain localization requirements. Samsung Electronics restricted its employee housing loans to units of 85 square meters or smaller in Seoul and metropolitan areas, responding to criticism that semiconductor bonuses were inflating housing prices. Next-generation battery technologies using tantalum are advancing, addressing longstanding issues with EV battery performance in cold weather and heat damage.
sections.Real Estate: Housing prices continue rising amid apartment supply shortages, with all surveyed real estate experts projecting sustained Seoul apartment price increases in the second half of 2026. Apartment lease transactions declined 7% year-over-year while villa transactions surged 11%, indicating middle-income consumers are shifting away from apartments toward more affordable housing options. Over half of respondents in their 20s and 30s criticized government real estate policies for failing to control house price increases, with 55% expecting further price appreciation over the next year. The shortage of apartments in desirable locations is driving renters toward multi-family homes and villas as alternative housing solutions.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve's new Chair Kevin Wash emphasized data-driven monetary policy during his first FOMC meeting in June, with half of Fed officials now projecting at least one rate hike for 2026 if inflation remains sticky. International crude oil prices dropped below $70 per barrel following Iran-related geopolitical tensions, reducing inflation pressures and supporting expectations for stable bond yields and dollar strength. Global mega-cap technology stocks, particularly US companies with AI exposure, are driving US equity markets higher, while Korean semiconductor stocks increasingly influence broader market trends. The FOMC minutes from June will be closely watched for signals on interest rate trajectory amid persistent inflation concerns from energy markets.
sections.AI & Economy: Artificial intelligence adoption is accelerating employment displacement, particularly among younger workers aged 15-29 who have experienced five consecutive months of job losses as companies replace standardized tasks with generative AI. SK Telecom announced plans to construct up to 15GW of AI data centers by 2035, positioning Korea as Asia's data center hub and leveraging the country's HBM capabilities and stable power infrastructure. Hyundai Motor Group committed 42 trillion won in investments over ten years across the Yeongnam region for AI-based autonomous vehicle hubs, advanced component clusters, and aerospace capabilities. The semiconductor industry's capital-intensive, automation-driven structure limits employment gains despite record export performance, with AI further accelerating labor displacement in information technology and professional services sectors.
sections.Others: Financial regulators are implementing protective measures against single-stock leverage ETF risks, including stricter deposit requirements and enhanced investor education similar to 2012 options trading regulations. Robinhood, the US online trading platform, is developing agent-based AI tools that would democratize algorithmic trading capabilities previously reserved for institutional investors. US-Iran geopolitical tensions and related statements from the Trump administration are creating uncertainty in international markets and influencing commodity price movements. Korean defense companies like Hanwha Systems are advancing unmanned maritime warfare capabilities with long-range ballistic missiles, responding to evolving global military technology paradigms.
